prompts.clean: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original tileable game PBR BASECOLOR source scan, one square image, ideally 2048 by 2048. Exactly orthographic overhead flat scan of a TWO METRE SQUARE field of smooth sealed brick-vermilion red pavement resin paint over dense grey concrete. This is continuous material, not a scene. Colour family is muted warm brick red, neutral unlit approximate sRGB #994333, not pink, orange terracotta, or black. Photographic authenticity with extremely fine paint micrograin and faint hairline use marks; most of the field is smooth and calm. Lighting must be perfectly even cross-polarized diffuse illumination: NO highlights, reflections, directional light, shadow, vignette, ambient shading or perspective. Material fills the complete image edge to edge. Four edges must join as a seamless repeat. NO panel seams, borders, bolts, lane markings, text, figures, gravel, brick grid, hexagons, dimples or objects. Structural seams and fasteners will be authored separately. The outer 10 percent of the image must remain quiet intact red so distinct wear can be tiled without chopped marks. Deliver exactly one opaque photographic colour source, not a montage, not labelled map channels. CONDITION: clean and maintained but handled, with 98 percent intact red coating. Very subtle naturally irregular manufacturing texture and barely visible faint overlapping cloth wipes, a few minute isolated primer specks. Restrained visual information and no large stain, no patch, no crack. Do not add grunge to make a dramatic texture.
